articles.summary: New daily route builds on JetBlue’s Fort Lauderdale growth and adds more choice between South Florida and Colombia To celebrate the launch, limited one-way fares are available starting at $134 in Main and $234 in EvenMore only at jetblue.com JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) launched today its new daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and Ernesto Cortissoz International Airport (BAQ) in Barranquilla, Colombia. The new service gives customers more choice and convenient travel options between South Florida and Colombia’s Caribbean coast. Barranquilla joins Medellín and Cartagena in JetBlue’s Colombian network, with service to Cali (CLO) set to launch later this month. Together, the new routes will bring JetBlue’s Colombian network to four destinations and further strengthen Fort Lauderdale’s role as a key gateway connecting customers across the United States, Latin America and the Caribbean. articles.summary: New partnership expands JetBlue’s commitment to Boston with game-day experiences, digital content and new opportunities connecting the airline with Boston College fans, alumni, students and athletes JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today announced a new partnership with Boston College Athletics, becoming the Official Airline of Boston College Athletics and further strengthening the airline’s ties to the Boston community. “Boston has been part of JetBlue’s story for more than two decades, and our partnership with Boston College is another exciting way for us to show up for the communities and fans who make this city special,” said Stephanie Evans Greene, senior vice president, marketing and brand at JetBlue and Boston College alumna. “The pride, passion and sense of community at BC are truly special, and I’m happy to see JetBlue become part of that. articles.summary: JetBlue Airways Corporation (Nasdaq: JBLU) announced today that it will hold its quarterly conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 27 th , 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. A live, listen-only webcast of the call will be available on JetBlue's investor relations website at the following web address: http://investor.jetblue.com For those unable to listen to the live webcast, it will also be archived on JetBlue's investor relations website under 'Archived Events Presentations' following the conference call. About JetBlue JetBlue is New York’s Hometown Airline® and a leading carrier in Boston, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood, Los Angeles, Orlando and San Juan. JetBlue carries customers to more than 100 destinations throughout the United States, Latin America, the Caribbean, Canada and Europe. For more information and the best fares, visit jetblue.com . JetBlue Investor Relations Tel: +1 718 709 2202 ir@jetblue.com Source: JetBlue

articles.summary: New daily route builds on JetBlue’s record growth in Fort Lauderdale as the airline continues to expand its largest-ever schedule at FLL To celebrate the launch, limited one-way fares are available starting at $139 in Main and $239 in EvenMore® only at jetblue.com JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today launched new daily nonstop service between Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and Alfonso Bonilla Aragón International Airport (CLO), serving Cali, Colombia. The launch marks another milestone in JetBlue’s expansion in both South Florida and Colombia, giving customers a new nonstop option between Fort Lauderdale and one of Colombia’s largest cities, while providing travelers from Cali with convenient connections through FLL to destinations across the airline’s growing network. Cali becomes JetBlue’s fourth destination in Colombia, joining Cartagena and Medellín, and follows the airline’s launch of Fort Lauderdale–Barranquilla service earlier this month. articles.summary: Debuting December 8, 2026 with daily service between Boston and Fort Lauderdale, BlueFirst brings JetBlue’s fresh take on first class to more customers Select introductory BlueFirst fares available now on jetblue.com from $249 one-way JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today announced that BlueFirst™, its new domestic first class, is available now for booking on select flights across more than 30 routes, giving customers their first opportunity to reserve a seat in JetBlue’s newest premium experience with limited time promotional fares as low as $249 one-way. BlueFirst will officially take flight on December 8, with its first-ever revenue flight connecting two of JetBlue’s largest focus cities, Boston and Fort Lauderdale. Within days, BlueFirst will expand to select flights between Fort Lauderdale and New York’s LaGuardia Airport (LGA), with additional routes to follow in the weeks and months ahead.
